confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors come from two web searches. One search found the RBA rate. The other found aggregated cost-of-living sites, which are crowdsourced and disagree with each other. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer price, at roughly 1.4x to 1.5x beer. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no listings checked. July is a normal season, but Dogo Onsen demand may push prices up. The RBA figure is for 2026-11-18, the latest published at generation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized regional Japanese city on Shikoku, with prices similar to Okayama or Kumamoto and below Tokyo or Osaka.
